summary: Phase 31 curriculum fixes (teacher chapter/topic contribution on published curriculum, full-detail drawer, review-comments loop) fully validated end-to-end against LIVE LPGS DB via public preview URL. Backend: pytest TestClient test_phase31.py 6/6 passed + new live-URL test_phase31_live.py 6/6 passed (12/12 total). Covered: admin detail returns comments/open_comment_count/can_review/can_comment, contributor teacher detail returns can_contribute + comments, unrelated-teacher 403 on GET /comments and POST /items (chapter), teacher 403 on POST /comments (reviewer-only), end-to-end admin->bell->teacher->resolve->bell loop (notification types ai_curriculum_comment + ai_comment_resolved verified), ai/approvals/curricula every row has open_comment_count field. Frontend: teacher /teacher/ai-tutor Grade 8 Mathematics shows PUBLISHED/AI ON, Add chapter/topic/material btn (data-testid ai-contribute-btn) + View full curriculum btn (ai-view-detail-btn). Contribute dialog material-type dropdown now contains both 'chapter' and 'topic' (+ 9 other types); switching to chapter renders chapter-name helper, switching to topic renders 'Topic name' input. Teacher drawer (ai-curriculum-detail) shows syllabus, full chapter->topic->materials structure with APPROVED/REJECTED/PENDING badges, per-item contributor+date, Review comments panel '2 open' with Resolve buttons on comments addressed to teacher and prior resolved comment with reply visible. Admin /app/ai-tutor has 3 tabs (Pending curricula / Pending contributions / Curricula browser). Browser row has ai-browse-detail-<id> that opens same drawer with AI Tutor checkbox (checked), per-item Comment buttons, review-comments count. ai-comment-input + ai-comment-send UI post succeeds (toast 'Comment added — the contributor was notified', count 2 open -> 3 open, comment appears PENDING with Resolve). Pending curricula tab is empty on live DB (Grade 8 Maths already published) so ai-pending-cur-comments-<id> badge not rendered (correct behavior, nothing to badge). Pending contributions tab shows no in-review item groups because current pending probe items are all REJECTED (not pending) — this is a data state artifact, not a bug.

issues: React hydration warning: visual-editor instrumentation injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>, which React warns is invalid HTML (span cannot be child of option). Functional impact: none (select still works), but console warning is noisy. Not a Phase 31 regression — appears to be a visual-editor overlay artifact.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: AICommentIn uses field name 'text' while frontend copy says 'review comment' — fine, but consider aliasing to 'body' for consistency with notification payload fields.

Pending contributions tab currently shows item groups only for items with status 'pending'; existing probe items are REJECTED and don't appear — expected, but reviewer could add an empty-state hint 'No pending contributions'.
Hydration warning <span> inside <option> originates from the visual-editor overlay instrumentation and is not a Phase 31 defect.
